title: DeepSeek-Prover V2 model card published
description: DeepSeek published the DeepSeek-Prover V2 model card focused on formal mathematical reasoning, theorem proving, and Lean 4 integration, with stronger results on miniF2F and PutnamBench.

title: Platform billing dashboard refresh
description: DeepSeek refreshed the platform billing dashboard with per-key spend graphs, cache-hit savings breakdowns, and CSV export for finance teams.

title: DeepSeek-R1-0710 general availability
description: DeepSeek promoted R1-0710 to stable availability for reasoning workloads with improved long-chain planning and lower latency.

title: DeepSeek-Coder V3 family
description: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-Coder V3 in 6.7B, 16B, and 33B variants with improved fill-in-the-middle, repository-level context handling, and function-call training.

title: Context window expanded to 512k tokens
description: DeepSeek expanded maximum context length for selected chat and reasoning endpoints, enabling larger document-grounded workflows.

title: Disk-based prompt cache pricing
description: DeepSeek introduced disk-based prompt caching with cache-hit pricing at $0.014 / MTok input, helping high-traffic apps cut average cost per request by 50–80%.

title: Function calling v2 released
description: DeepSeek introduced structured function calling v2 with stricter argument schemas and improved tool routing reliability.

title: R1 distill refresh on Hugging Face
description: DeepSeek refreshed the open-weights R1-Distill family (Qwen 1.5B/7B/14B/32B and Llama 8B/70B variants) with retraining on a cleaner reasoning trace dataset.

title: Deterministic JSON mode launched
description: DeepSeek added deterministic JSON output mode for automation workflows that require strict parseable responses.

title: Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint
description: DeepSeek added an Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint at /anthropic/v1/messages, letting users point existing Claude SDK code at DeepSeek with a single base URL change.

title: Vision understanding enters beta
description: DeepSeek published beta multimodal inference support for image+text prompts in core chat endpoints, with tested vision benchmarks across MMMU, DocVQA, ChartQA, and MathVista.

title: DeepSeek-VL2 open-weights checkpoints
description: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-VL2 in 1B, 2.8B, and 4.5B activated-parameter MoE variants under MIT, with stronger OCR, document understanding, and visual grounding than VL1.

title: Off-peak pricing window expanded
description: DeepSeek extended its off-peak (16:30–00:30 UTC) discount to 50% off both input and output tokens for chat and reasoner endpoints, including cached input tokens.

title: Batch inference API released
description: DeepSeek launched asynchronous batch inference endpoints for high-throughput offline jobs and evaluation pipelines, priced at 50% of synchronous chat completion rates.

title: DeepSeek-Coder V3 Instruct + agentic SFT
description: DeepSeek published DeepSeek-Coder V3 Instruct checkpoints with agentic supervised fine-tuning data and a SWE-bench Verified score of 49.3% on the 33B variant.

title: DeepSeek-R2 reasoning model preview
description: DeepSeek announced a public preview of DeepSeek-R2, a next-generation reasoning model trained with iterated RLHF and process-reward fine-tuning, with stronger AIME, GPQA Diamond, and CodeForces results than R1-0710.

title: DeepSeek-TTS research preview
description: DeepSeek published a research preview of DeepSeek-TTS, a streaming text-to-speech model trained for low-latency conversational agents, alongside a public benchmark suite.

title: Enterprise org controls and key scopes
description: DeepSeek added organization-level key scopes, usage limits, and audit-ready access controls for enterprise deployments, plus SSO via SAML 2.0 and SCIM-based user provisioning.

title: DeepSeek-R1-0822 rollout
description: DeepSeek announced an updated R1 series model with stronger coding and agentic-tool benchmarks and better multilingual reasoning, replacing R1-0710 as the default reasoner endpoint.

title: DeepSeek-V4 API support
description: DeepSeek API added V4-Pro and V4-Flash through both OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic-compatible interfaces; legacy deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner model names are scheduled for discontinuation on July 24, 2026.

title: DeepSeek-V4 technical report published
description: DeepSeek published the DeepSeek-V4 technical report on arXiv, detailing a 671B-parameter MoE architecture with 21B activated parameters, multi-head latent attention v2, and an expanded multi-token prediction objective.

title: DeepSeek-V4-Base open weights
description: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4-Base and DeepSeek-V4-Base-FP8 checkpoints on Hugging Face under MIT, alongside vLLM and SGLang inference scripts and an FP8 calibration recipe.

title: DeepSeek Evals Suite released
description: DeepSeek published an official evaluation suite and benchmark harness for regression testing across chat, coding, and reasoning tasks, with reference reports across V3, V4, R1-0822, and Coder V3.

title: Streaming tool-call delta fix
description: DeepSeek shipped a streaming fix that emits well-formed delta chunks for tool calls when responses are truncated mid-argument, unblocking common Anthropic SDK and OpenAI SDK migrations.

title: 1M-token context with auto-paged cache for V4-Pro
description: DeepSeek-V4-Pro reached a 1M-token context window in production with an auto-paged disk cache backend that holds long contexts across requests at cache-hit pricing.

title: DeepSeek-VL3 multimodal preview
description: DeepSeek opened a developer preview of DeepSeek-VL3 with native image, video, and screenshot understanding for agentic computer-use workloads, plus a 256k multimodal context window.
